what.title: Join the MicoPay Network
what.lead: Give cash to people who need it and earn a commission for doing so.
what.body: Agents are what make cash available in MicoPay. When someone near you wants to convert crypto to bills, you hand them the cash and receive crypto plus your commission.
what.noBusiness: You don't need to have a business. It can be a store, a stall, or an individual. We don't require business paperwork.
what.decisions: You decide your commission, your amounts, and your schedule. No one assigns you trades: you accept the ones you want.
what.noMode: You'll keep using MicoPay as usual. Being an agent doesn't put you in a separate mode: you can request a cash-out as a customer whenever you want.

expect.title: What it involves
expect.lead: It's worth knowing beforehand, not afterward.
expect.identity: You'll need to verify your identity. It's not optional: handling cash in exchange for digital assets requires it by law from the first peso.
expect.area: We'll publish your area, not your address. The exact meeting point is only visible to the other person once a trade is underway, and they stop seeing it when it ends.
expect.cash: You need to have cash available when you accept a trade. If you don't, pause: it takes one tap.
expect.meetup: You'll meet strangers in person. Choose a public, busy place.

welcome.lead: Before you start: three minutes that can save you a headache.
welcome.walletText: Your MicoPay account is your wallet. It's not like a bank app: we don't hold your money and we can't move it. Only you can.
welcome.walletKey: Your secret key lives in your wallet. MicoPay never sees it: you review and approve every movement there.
welcome.walletWarning: That also means if you lose access to your wallet and didn't save its recovery phrase, nobody can give your funds back. Not even us. And we will never ask for it: whoever asks for it wants to take your money.
welcome.phoneText: MicoPay just created your own account inside this phone. It's not like a bank app: we don't hold your money and we can't move it. Only you can.
welcome.phoneKey: Your account is protected by a secret key that lives only on this device and never leaves it.
welcome.phoneWarning: That also means if you lose your phone and didn't back up your key, nobody can give your funds back. Not even us. It's not something that can be replaced.
welcome.backupLead: It's the only step you can't undo later.
welcome.backupText1: Keep your secret key somewhere safe and off the phone: written on paper, or in a password manager. Whoever has that key controls your funds, so don't share it with anyone, no matter how much they ask.
welcome.backupText2: You can explore the app without backing it up, but we'll ask for it before your first trade with money.
welcome.cashoutLead: MicoPay connects people, not bank branches.
welcome.cashoutText: In MicoPay, the one who gives or takes your cash is another person: a MicoPay Network agent. It can be a shop, a stall or an individual near you.
welcome.cashoutSell: Cash out: you hand over crypto and the agent gives you bills.
welcome.cashoutBuy: Buy with cash: you hand over bills and the agent gives you crypto.
welcome.cashoutFee: The agent charges a small fee that you see before accepting. No surprises later.
welcome.escrowLead: The money is held until the exchange happens.
welcome.escrowText: When you accept a trade, the crypto isn't handed to anyone yet: it's locked in escrow, out of reach of both sides.
welcome.escrowRelease: It's released only when the cash changes hands and both confirm it in the app.
welcome.escrowTimeout: If the trade isn't completed in time, you get your funds back. The app shows you the button to do it.
welcome.escrowNobody: That's why neither side can keep the money and disappear.
welcome.meetingLead: This happens in person. Good to know beforehand.
welcome.meetingZone: You'll see the agent's area before accepting. The exact address only appears once the trade is underway, and only to the two of you.
welcome.meetingQr: When you meet, one shows a QR code and the other scans it. That scan is the proof that the cash was handed over.
welcome.meetingSafe: Meet in a busy public place, during the day. If anything feels off, cancel: you don't have to complete anything.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draft: DRAFT — Pending legal review. This is not legal advice.
privacy.s1Body: We collect the information needed to run the service: your username, your public Stellar address and the transaction history linked to your account.
privacy.s1IdvBody: To exchange cash↔crypto the law requires us to identify you. Our provider Didit does that verification on behalf of MicoPay, on its own page: there you capture your official ID (INE or passport) and a selfie, and Didit may validate your CURP. The selfie and the comparison of your face are
privacy.s1IdvSensitive: biometric data, which the law considers sensitive personal data
privacy.s1IdvConsent: , and they are only processed with your express consent, which you give when you start the verification.
privacy.s1Storage: MicoPay does not store your documents, your selfie or your CURP on its servers. We only keep the result: whether you were approved or rejected, the verification level, the date and, if rejected, a reason code (for example, expired document).
privacy.s2Intro: We use your information only to:
privacy.s3Body: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for commercial purposes. Transactions are recorded on the public Stellar network, which is inherent to how the blockchain works.
privacy.s3Providers: We work with these providers, who process your data only to provide their service to us:
privacy.s3Etherfuse: only if you use CETES or SPEI; it runs its own verification and receives your email.
privacy.s4Body: We apply reasonable technical measures to protect your information, including encryption in transit (HTTPS) and at rest for sensitive data. However, no system is 100% secure.
privacy.s5Intro: You can request deletion of your account directly from the Profile section of the app. Our data deletion policy ensures maximum minimization of personal data (PII):
privacy.s5AnonBody: Your username, public Stellar address and phone hash are permanently removed and replaced with fully anonymous, untraceable values.
privacy.s5DeleteBody: Your wallet record and all push notification tokens (FCM) are completely removed from our database.
privacy.s5ChatBody: Your chat messages are completely deleted, and details or evidence in reported disputes are purged of identifiable data.
privacy.s5LedgerBody: To comply with platform security and integrity rules, the trade history and the hashes of public transactions on the Stellar ledger are kept, linked only to your anonymized profile.
privacy.s5Contact: For questions about the process or to exercise other ARCO rights, contact us at
privacy.s6Body: We will notify relevant changes through the app. Continued use of the service means you accept the current policy.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.draft: DRAFT — Pending legal review. This is not legal advice.
terms.s1Body: By using Micopay you accept these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service. Using the app means you are of legal age and have the legal capacity to carry out financial transactions in your country of residence.
terms.s2Body: Micopay is a P2P platform that makes it easier to exchange physical cash for digital assets (XLM/USDC) using smart contracts on the Stellar network. Micopay acts as a technical intermediary, not as a bank or financial institution.
terms.s3Item1: Use the service only for legitimate transactions
terms.s3Item3: Do not use the platform for money laundering or other illegal activities
terms.s3Item4: Check the operation details before confirming
terms.s4Body: Micopay charges a platform fee shown before you confirm each operation. Stellar network fees are minimal and are also paid by the user.
terms.s5Body: Micopay is not liable for losses from price volatility, user errors, Stellar network failures, or a counterparty failing to perform in a P2P transaction. You use the service at your own risk.
terms.s6Body: You can delete your account at any time from the Profile section. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these terms.
terms.s7Body: For questions about these terms, write to us at {{email}}.
